spellbook.finance/limitations: workspaceId validates caller ownership only. Combined-shipping rules belong to the connected eBay account and can affect eligible listings across all of the caller's workspaces.
A provider rule readback does not prove a listing is associated or a buyer receives the discount at checkout.
Use missingFields and limitations for association and checkout evidence.

description: Read the caller's connected eBay combined-shipping rule, promotional shipping threshold and provider status. workspaceId proves the caller owns a SpellBook workspace; account settings remain scoped to that caller's eBay account. Read before changing the rule.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.
